Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction

This document outlines the 
 equipment inspection I1 on UPS 220 V battery, which 
must be performed every two months as indicated by M2 in the title block .
Technical Specification of Battery:
Technical Specification of Battery:

The first draft initiated by eng. Saad Mahmoud El-Nashaar, tested by eng. Reda 
Ragab Karam, accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam, accepted by 
eng. Gaber Mahmoud farahat head sector of Damanhour power station and
certified by eng. Sania 
Diab Attia : WDEPC Inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.

Safety 
Precautions

A 
work permit must be issued
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, 
safety glasses, rubber apron, eye rinsing device is required.

items:
A 
work permit must be issued
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, 
safety glasses, rubber apron, eye rinsing device is required.

No smoking is permitted 
 in battery room.

Do not place any tools 
 on top of battery cells (danger of short circuit).

Never use the same 
 tools on these cells, you may be used before on lead acid cells.

sections.text:
Tools and 
Equipment

items:
Personal safety equipment, safety 
 goggles, and rubber gloves and rubber apron.

Standard screwdrivers set, density meter, voltmeter, brushes, distilled water, 
 and rags.

sections.text: Work to be carried out

Read overall voltage of bank and 
record on battery maintenance card.
Clean the battery.

Check the electrolyte level and add 
distilled water (if necessary).

Check the pole and connectors and 
clean any salt deposits with distilled water.
Check that connections are tightened.

Lubricate the pole and connectors 
with vaseline including the disco and nuts.

Read voltage per cell and record on 
battery maintenance card.

Take the electrolyte density and 
record on battery maintenance card.

Again read overall voltage of bank 
and record on battery maintenance card and compare the reading from step no.1

Compare the present reading with the 
last reading.

Check the temperature inside the 
battery room not exceeding 45C 
maximum and 20 degree min.

Check the ventilation of the 
battery room to ensure their correct operation.
